subject: Private environment onboarding: POC -> Production sequencing, SOW updates & PO
messages:
From: Elise Romero <elise.romero@medify.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medify.io>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC -> Prod: timeline and isolation requirements

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the POC last month — the team is happy with latency and model consistency. We need to move a subset of traffic to a dedicated private on‑prem environment at contract renewal (targeting production cutover in Q1). Key asks:

- Dedicated cluster(s) deployed in our primary DC (PHX), fully isolated VPC peering — no cross‑tenant KV cache sharing.
- Staging mirror for canary rollouts.
- 99.9% token‑level SLA for the prod cluster.

We have a procurement review the week of Nov 8 and would like an updated SOW + proposed PO by then. We also have one operational constraint: because the renewal aligns with our fiscal quarter close, we need a modest provisioning credit or invoice timing flexibility to keep go‑live within budget this quarter. Is Redwood able to provide a one‑time migration/term credit tied to the new on‑prem SOW?

I've attached a short requirements spreadsheet to help scope (Medify_VPC_requirements.xlsx). Can you loop in your delivery and pricing leads?

Appreciate it —
Elise
Director of Platform Engineering
Medify Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Romero <elise.romero@medify.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC -> Prod: timeline and isolation requirements

Elise —

Great to hear the POC went well. Thank you for the requirements doc. Short answer: we can support an isolated on‑prem cluster with a staging mirror and propose a targeted cutover in Q1. To move quickly we'll do the following:

1) Draft SOW that scopes dedicated cluster builds, VPC peering configuration, and a 30‑day staged cutover plan. Attached: SOW_draft_v2.pdf.
2) Price schedule and optional one‑time migration credit for term alignment — I’ve looped in Kimberly for the pricing and PO/credit conversation.
3) Delivery sequencing & rough schedule — we’ll validate capacity and provide a firm provisioning window within 48 hours.

Next steps from our side: Kimberly will share pricing/options and Marissa will lead onboarding once PO/SOW are signed. Can you confirm who in Procurement will submit the PO and whether DocuSign is the preferred signature flow?

Jonas
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

(attachment: SOW_draft_v2.pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Romero <elise.romero@medify.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC -> Prod: timeline and isolation requirements

Hi Elise —

Thanks for the clear requirements. Quick summary of the commercial path and an ask on credits:

- Option A (standard): Dedicated private environment + staging mirror + standard onboarding — one‑time setup fee $85k + monthly subscription per cluster.
- Option B (accelerated): Expedited provisioning (2‑week turn) + hands‑on migration support — one‑time fee $120k, includes 40 hours of migration engineering.

Given your timeline constraint at fiscal close, we can offer a one‑time migration credit of $20k applied to the first invoice for customers that commit to a 12‑month Dedicated contract and sign the SOW by Nov 15. If you need different payment timing instead of a credit (e.g., net‑60 invoicing for the setup amount), we can accommodate with procurement.

I’ve attached a pricing summary (pricing_summary.xlsx). @Priyom — can you validate capacity for an accelerated Option B provisioning window the week of Nov 22+ and confirm any SLA exceptions we should flag?

Kimberly
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: pricing_summary.xlsx)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Elise Romero <elise.romero@medify.io>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC -> Prod: timeline and isolation requirements

Folks —

Capacity check and sequencing: we have available on‑prem capacity reserved in PHX for Dedicated customers. For an accelerated Option B cutover we estimate the following windows:

- Week 1 (provisioning): 3 business days to provision initial private cluster and networking (hardware already assigned).
- Week 2 (harden + testing): 5 business days to run canary workloads and KV cache isolation validation.
- Week 3 (staging mirror & cutover prep): 2 business days for final sync and dry‑run.

Risk notes: A full 99.9% token‑level SLA requires an agreed maintenance blackout window and an exception for major kernel backport work (we'll document in the SOW). For the accelerated flow, ops will require a single on‑site verification day (remote acceptable with partner access).

Attached is a short sequencing plan (cluster_sequencing_plan.md). If procurement can sign the SOW and PO by Nov 15 we can target a Jan 10 production cutover.

Priyom
Head of Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
(attachment: cluster_sequencing_plan.md)
From: Elise Romero <elise.romero@medify.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medify.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2026 14:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC -> Prod: timeline and isolation requirements

Thanks — this all looks reasonable. Procurement has confirmed they can commit to a 12‑month Dedicated contract and will sign if we include the $20k migration credit in the SOW. I’ve attached the PO for review (PO_Medify_20261105.pdf).

DocuSign is preferred. Can you send the final SOW with the credit applied and the DocuSign envelope so procurement can complete signatures by Nov 12? We’ll route the PO internally once the SOW is in DocuSign.

Best,
Elise
(attachment: PO_Medify_20261105.pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Romero <elise.romero@medify.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC -> Prod: timeline and isolation requirements

Elise —

Appreciate the PO and the quick turnaround. We’ve updated the SOW to reflect Option B with the $20k migration credit and clarified the maintenance blackout window exception. Attached: SOW_final_for_signing.pdf. I’ve also created a DocuSign envelope (https://www.docusign.com/transaction/abc123-medify-sow) and invited Procurement.

Once signed we’ll confirm exact provisioning dates with Priyom and Marissa will schedule the onboarding kickoff. Targeting the Jan 10 cutover as discussed.
